setups.pullback: Trend pullback: daily trend, a real 4h pullback into the 4h 50 EMA zone, then a strong 4h close back with the trend
setups.breakout: 20-day breakout: a 4h close through the 20-day high (low) on 1.5x volume, daily trend not against it
setups.flush: Flush reversal: a fast 3.5 ATR drop (spike) that cuts open interest by 5%+ (liquidations), then a 4h close back past the middle
setups.crowded: Crowded fade: funding in the top (bottom) 10% of the coin's 90 days, open interest +10% in 3 days, price stalling, then a 4h close through the 20 EMA against the crowd
setups.strength: Relative strength: once a day, the 5 strongest (weakest) coins vs BTC in a daily uptrend (downtrend), when BTC itself trends that way
setups.trend: Benchmark, not a setup: once a day, any coin in a daily uptrend (long) or downtrend (short). A setup has to beat this

exits.trail: Stop to break-even at +1R, then trail 2.5 ATR(4h) from +1.5R, max 20 days
exits.time5: No target: stop, or sell after 5 days
